title: The Journey Back Home
content:
After ending the call...

Sneha remained seated on the park bench.

For a long moment...

She simply stared at her phone.

Then...

A smile slowly spread across her face.

The happiness she had been longing to feel for five long years had finally found its way back into her heart.

"He called me..."

She whispered to herself.

"He really called me..."

Unable to contain her excitement any longer...

She immediately dialled Yashwanth's number.

The call was answered within a few rings.

"Hello, Sneha?"

Before Yashwanth could say anything else...

She excitedly began speaking.

"Yashwanth..."

"I'm coming."

"I'll definitely come to your wedding."

Yashwanth smiled.

"I knew you would."

Sneha laughed softly.

"It's because..."

She paused for a moment before smiling to herself.

"Siddu invited me."

Yashwanth couldn't help but smile.

"So..."

"You two finally spoke."

Sneha nodded instinctively, forgetting they were on a phone call.

"Yes."

"It wasn't a long conversation..."

"But it was enough."

"I've been waiting for this moment for five years."

"I'm not going to miss it."

"I'm really happy for you, Yashwanth."

"And thank you..."

"For trying to bring us back together."

Yashwanth smiled warmly.

"I didn't do anything."

"The credit belongs to fate."

After exchanging a few more words...

They ended the call.

________________________________________

A few minutes later...

Sneha called Shreya.

The moment Shreya answered...

She immediately noticed the happiness in Sneha's voice.

"You sound different today."

"What happened?"

Sneha couldn't stop smiling.

"He called."

Shreya smiled knowingly.

"Siddu?"

Sneha softly replied,

"Yes."

The two friends spoke for a long time.

By the end of the conversation...

They had made their decision.

Yashwanth's wedding was three weeks away.

They would leave for India in two weeks.

________________________________________

The days passed quickly.

Everyone became busy with their own responsibilities.

Wedding preparations had already begun in Shimla.

Siddu spent his days helping Yashwanth with every arrangement.

Meanwhile...

Sneha found herself thinking about only one thing.

"I'll finally meet Siddu again."

She wanted that reunion to be special.

She wanted to give him something that would always remind him of this day.

One afternoon...

She decided to buy him a gift.

Something simple...

Yet meaningful.

She called Yagnesh and asked him to accompany her.

The two of them visited one of the city's finest jewellery stores.

Rows of beautifully crafted bracelets, watches, and accessories filled the displays.

Sneha carefully examined each bracelet.

"No..."

"This isn't right."

She gently placed another one back on the counter.

Minutes turned into hours.

They looked through dozens of designs.

Even Yagnesh had begun to feel exhausted.

Sneha smiled helplessly.

"One last try."

She slowly walked toward another display.

Then...

Her eyes suddenly stopped on a simple yet elegant silver bracelet.

The moment she picked it up...

A beautiful smile appeared on her face.

"This is the one."

She gently ran her fingers across it.

For a brief moment...

She imagined fastening it around Siddu's wrist herself.

"I hope you'll like it..."

She whispered softly.

Yagnesh smiled.

"I had a feeling you'd find the perfect one."

Sneha carefully packed the bracelet.

"This isn't just a gift."

"It's something I've wanted to give him for a very long time."

________________________________________

Two weeks passed.

Everything was finally ready.

Sneha...

Shreya...

And Yagnesh...

Arrived at the airport together.

After completing the formalities...

They boarded their flight.

Each of them quietly settled into their seats.

As the aircraft slowly began moving along the runway...

Sneha looked out through the window.

The city that had witnessed both her happiest memories and her deepest loneliness slowly disappeared beneath the clouds.

Soon...

The aircraft soared high into the endless blue sky.

Sneha gently held the small gift box in her hands.

Her heart raced with excitement.

After five long years...

She was finally going to see Siddu again.

She wondered...

Would he smile when he saw her?

Would he still look at her the same way?

Would the distance between them finally disappear?

Countless questions filled her heart.

But beneath every one of them...

There was only one feeling.

Hope.

The journey back to India had begun.

And somewhere beyond the endless clouds...

Fate was quietly preparing the reunion that two hearts had been waiting for...

For five long years.
